title: Mindloop Landing
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci && npm run build'

checks.production_build: passed: TypeScript and Vite; dist/index.html exists
checks.browser: Chromium via playwright-core against production dist with HTTP byte-range support
checks.horizontal_overflow: none at either viewport throughout page
checks.images: all 6 images loaded at both viewports
checks.video: all 3 supplied MP4s and exact supplied HLS stream reached readyState 4 and played at both viewports
checks.visual_review: desktop, mobile, and full page reviewed

asset_issues.issue: No original avatar or platform-icon files were present in the project.
asset_issues.resolution: Downloaded local avatar PNGs and rasterized the matching platform marks from SVG sources. Provenance and regeneration scripts are documented in README.md.

notes: All work confined to this project. No deployment, push, other sessions, subagents, or messaging.
The exact supplied CloudFront MP4s are included locally; fonts are bundled locally. HLS remains an external network dependency.
Forms validate email and save interest only in browser localStorage. No backend was specified and no email is sent.
Social account URLs were not provided; social links open the corresponding platform homepage.
Vite reports a nonfatal chunk-size advisory for the HLS engine bundle.
Source, dependency lockfile, real static build, screenshots, and reproducible browser-check script are included.
